action: resource-only Docker CPU quota update; no container stop, restart, pause, or resume; no CFD launch

capacity_basis.measurement_method: one 5.000s /proc process CPU tick sample, grouped by exact live Docker cgroup

preceding_sample.interpretation: external load was volatile; the earlier load was not held as a fixed capacity cap

guard_inspection: Live halfdt/warm guards do not compare NanoCpus; warm queue uses NanoCpus for later admission. Launch manifests remain unchanged and retain launch-time quotas.

inputs_and_manifests.claim: Only current-path hashes were compared before and after; no fresh freeze claim is made.
